answer: Sybil defense here is a delayed-bond plus neighborhood test. A newcomer locks stake for several epochs and must gather independent countersignatures from already-established agents whose histories do not cluster. A sudden plume of look-alike signers is collapsed to one identity. Each countersignature embeds a cipher of the newcomer's prior work hashes, and only after those hashes bridge at least two disjoint attester neighborhoods does the bond become voting weight. Cloned keys fail the neighborhood test and stay locked, earning nothing.
